text:
maria: Quick sync - ops wants automatic fallback on rollout for route `gptq-6k`. We need minimal console UX + telemetry.

ben: Must have dry-run mode and sample toggle (default 5%). Events show up but don't re-route until promoted.

yuki: Telemetry minimal set: event_id, route, trigger (e.g. "latency_95>1s"), trigger_value, degrade_mode, sample_flag, affected_pct, preceding_request_id, trace_link, audit_user, audit_reason.

maria: UI: left = route config + Dry-run / Active toggle, center = compact timeline of fallback events, right = details with trace + buttons: Promote | Replay | Rollback | Create Incident.

ben: Add cost_estimate field and require explicit acknowledge if cost delta > threshold. Also require a short reason for promote/override.

yuki: For triggers allow composite rules. UI should list which subconditions fired and a confidence score. Also include a small sparkline of latency + error-rate.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary started 1779998886 -> 5% sample for route=gptq-6k.

maria: Backend: new table route_fallback_events with raw_payload and replay_id. API endpoints: GET /routes/{id}/events, POST /events/{id}/promote. Promote should check safety_checks_passed boolean.

ben: Owners: Ben -> telemetry + cost gating, Yuki -> policy + composite triggers render, Maria -> console layout + promote flow. We'll hold global flip until 24h canary dry-run data.

maria: Thanks all, drop quick edits here if you think we missed fields.
